avoid: Sharp metal props or real swords
children.counts: 4 counts forward running, 4 counts backward running.
children.game_version: A playful game of 'flower opening' where two lines of children run towards each other and step back on drum signals while wearing cardboard horse hoops.

seniors.counts: Simple 4-count forward walking step and 4-count backward walking step.
seniors.seated_version: Performers sit in a chair holding the light mock-horse frame on their lap, practicing arm movements and sword flourishes to the rhythm.
seniors.standing_version: Performers walk slowly back and forth in line rather than running fast, holding the frame at a relaxed pace.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo to a steady walking pace; limited forward/backward stride range.

learning_units.description: Learn the opposing line running pattern creating the flower opening visual.

social_formats.description: Group performance in opposing facing lines running back and forth in coordination.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: One or both hands wielding swords in mock-fight motions
movement_profile.footwork: Quick back-and-forth running steps marked by ghungroo bells at the ankles
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Opposite rows of dancers running back and forth in coordinated lines
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Controlled torso stability inside the papier-mâché and bamboo horse shell
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Ground-level running and swift directional shifts; jumps not described in sources
movement_profile.partnering: Paired mock fighting with swords between opposing dancers
movement_profile.posture: Upright posture with dancer positioned inside a waist-mounted horse frame

signature_moves.description: Opposing dancers running back and forth quickly, creating a floral illusion when seen from above.
signature_moves.name: Opening flower formation

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid collisions with opposing dancers while performing fast sword passes within costume constraints.

music_profile.musical_form: Vocal narration accompanied by percussive drum and flute rhythms
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Rhythmic percussive patterns driven by dhol beats and ghungroo ankle bells
music_profile.sound_description: A dynamic combination of deep dhol drumbeats, melodic flute lines, percussive ankle-bell jingles, and loud narrative singing describing mock sword fights and legendary bandits.
music_profile.vocal_style: Narrative singing chronicling stories and exploits of local bandits

basic_steps: Step into the horse costume frame and secure it at the waist.
Tie ghungroo (ankle bells) securely around both ankles.
Hold a sword in hand while maintaining upright posture inside the dummy horse frame.
Perform rapid back-and-forth linear runs directly facing another dancer to form intersecting flower-like patterns.
teaching.formation: Linear facing lines where opposing rows of dancers run back and forth.
teaching.level_notes: Requires coordination to maneuver inside a rigid costume frame while handling a prop sword.
teaching.rhythm: Rhythmic percussive beats driven by the dhol and punctuated by ankle bells (ghungroo).
